subject: Hopscotch dedicated throughput demo — preflight & calendar coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah@hopscotch.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Liu <michael@hopscotch.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hopscotch signup: dedicated capacity demo request

Hi Monica,

We just finished the self-serve trial on the Redwood dashboard and selected a Dedicated capacity trial slot. Our engineering lead Michael and I would like a short demo focused on throughput and latency characteristics for committed capacity — specifically: 99th percentile latency at 1k QPS, batching strategies, and KV-cache behavior for long context workloads.

Can we schedule a 45-minute session this week or early next week? Our timezone is PDT.

I attached a quick export of our current request profile (hopscotch_throughput_estimates.xlsx) so you can get a sense of sequence lengths and concurrency expectations.

Thanks,
Sarah Klein
Head of ML Engineering, Hopscotch AI
attachments: hopscotch_throughput_estimates.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah@hopscotch.ai>
Cc: Michael Liu <michael@hopscotch.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hopscotch signup: dedicated capacity demo request

Thanks Sarah — great to see the profile. I can run the demo and do a short preflight with our solutions engineering team to make sure we hit the right throughput during the hands-on portion.

Suggested agenda (45m):
- 5m: intros & goals
- 15m: dedicated pool sizing + expected latency at target QPS
- 15m: live walkthrough (batching, KV cache, autoscale lane)
- 10m: next steps (pilot timeline, trial commit)

Times I have available (PDT): Wed 8/4 10:30–11:15, Thu 8/5 14:00–14:45, Fri 8/6 09:00–09:45. If none of those work I can ask Ben to spin up additional slots.

Could you also confirm whether you want us to simulate 40% of requests as long-context (3k tokens)? If yes, please call that out in the spreadsheet.

I'll include our technical lead for preflight details once we lock time.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Klein <sarah@hopscotch.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Monica — Thu 8/5 14:00–14:45 PDT works for us. Michael will join and can answer the sim details.

We do want ~40% long-context (2.5–3k tokens). Also, one ask: during the walkthrough can you show how Redwood would handle a burst to ~1.5k QPS for 30s (we have that traffic pattern during batch inference windows)?

Attaching a short latency dump from our internal tests (poe_latency_report.pdf) for context.

Thanks,
Sarah
